changelog:
- Initial release of Graph Path Reasoning Analyzer.
- Enables analysis and discovery of paths between entities in knowledge graphs.
- Supports finding shortest path, all paths, path filtering, ranking, and explainability.
- Provides natural language explanations and detailed reasoning over graph traversals.
- Includes multiple algorithms (BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, K-shortest, all-pairs shortest) and path ranking/filtering techniques.
display_name: Knowledge Graph - Graph Path Reasoning Analyzer
summary: Analyze and discover paths between entities in knowledge graphs to explain relationships, identify indirect connections, and provide reasoning over traversal...
